$comment: Committed renderer bundle ceilings, read by scripts/check-bundle-budget.ts. The rule is 10-testing-and-quality.md, "Client budgets" (D10-13) and 07-client-applications.md §9.4: at most 900 KB gzip total and 350 KB gzip for the initial route chunk, where KB is 1024 bytes. An entry here may tighten those ceilings but never loosen them — raising a number above the plan's is an edit to the plan, and the check fails on a budget that exceeds it.
